## Summary
- [ ] Describe the portal change and acceptance criteria.
- [ ] Preserve canonical repository/module names and source-of-truth links.

## Weakness → verified capability
- Limitation and evidence:
- Implemented behavior:
- Remaining external dependency or boundary:

## Documentation and UI
- [ ] README and affected UA/EN/RU variants are current.
- [ ] Portal follows `docs/gui/GUI_DESIGN_STANDARD.md` and existing Duck tokens.
- [ ] Simulation content is labelled; no external runtime/hardware claims.
- [ ] Module maturity and provenance links are correct.
- [ ] Actual screenshots are used; conceptual wireframes are labelled.

## Verification
- [ ] Portal tests and CI pass.
- [ ] HTML/CSS/JS, registry, manifest and schema checks pass.
- [ ] Navigation, search, filters, empty/loading/error states and copy feedback checked.
- [ ] Changed code meets 80% coverage where configured or exception documented.
- [ ] Security, privacy, external links and accessibility reviewed.

## Review policy
- Branches: `feature/<ticket>-<slug>`, `fix/<slug>`, `docs/<slug>`.
- No direct commits to protected default/release branches.
- Merge requires two independent approvals and all required CI checks, enforced via branch protection.
- [ ] Two independent approvals.
- [ ] Required CI checks green.

## Українська / Русский
- [ ] Каталог, статуси зрілості та посилання на джерела перевірені.
- [ ] Симуляції явно відділені від реальних runtime та обладнання.
- [ ] Два незалежні схвалення й успішний CI перед злиттям.
